# Iamblichus

*245 – 325 · Syrian · [Neoplatonism](../movements/neoplatonism.md)*

Greek-speaking Syrian philosopher, a pupil of Porphyry, who brought theurgy into [Neoplatonism](../movements/neoplatonism.md): in his view, reason alone cannot unite the soul with the gods, rites are needed as well.
